تغتابوا (form VIII)
# تَغْتَابُوا (taḡtābū) /taɣ.taː.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَابَ (iḡtāba)
# تُغْتَابُوا (tuḡtābū) /tuɣ.taː.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَابَ (iḡtāba)
